# awacino_members (Data Source)

The company's members (not removed ones), optionally filtered. Key section **Users** (Read).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_members" "provisioned" {
  role   = "read"
  status = "active"
}

output "provisioned_emails" {
  value = [for m in data.awacino_members.provisioned.members : m.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Only this invited address.
- `external_id` (String) Only this external_id.
- `role` (String) Only this role.
- `status` (String) Only this status (`invited`, `active`, `deactivated`).

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `accepted_at` (String) Joined.
- `can_agentic` (Boolean) May use agentic AI.
- `can_automation` (Boolean) May use automation.
- `created_at` (String) Created.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `email` (String) Invited address.
- `external_id` (String) Your own id.
- `id` (String) Member id.
- `role` (String) `main_admin`, `admin`, `auditor`, `user` or `read`.
- `status` (String) `invited`, `active` or `deactivated`.
